I travelled through Afghanistan many years ago, not as a tourist but en route hitch-hiking to West Berlin, checking the map daily to see the shortest route for the next day's road & destination going West.  A local bus, Chevrolet 'taxi' with people packed into its boot, along the back window ledge, on the floor behind the driver (about 12 people, from memory) & a horse-drawn cart were the different forms of transport.  There was literally nothing romantic & we were constantly on guard against aggressive males.  I was chased from attempting to wash my hands under the tap outside the corrugated 'toilet', a hole in the dirt, an older man used a small mirror to shine the sun into my husband's eyes to 'blind the demon in him', & on the way in the local bus with only males across the rocky moonscape where not a blade of grass, bush or tree was to be seen, the men kept staring menacingly at us sitting at the very back away from the pack.  When the bus stopped suddenly we wondered what had happened, until my husband told me not to look because they had seen a single lost sheep & the knives came out & made quick work of the unfortunate creature, cutting it into parts.  The killing excitement/lust was like nothing my husband had ever seen growing up on a farm in Victoria, Australia.  Peeping Toms were also part of the 'cultural' experience we were subjected to.  

Where men are sexually deprived, much like Catholic priests, energy flows elsewhere, be it masturbation, peeping Toms, or the infamous dancing boys of Afghanistan who are dressed as girls to dance & entertain a male audience & then be sexually misused by them.  A rugged landscape & harsh climate do not explain widespread cruelty & depravity.  Japan, by comparison, has mastered its rugged terrain & harsh climate to create an admirable disciplined, cultured, educated society.  Islam creates the very opposite.
